title: Your Content Is Already a Book
excerpt: You've probably already written 2-3 books. You just haven't assembled them yet.

Why a book

The most lasting thing you can make.

You already have the newsletter, the course, and the sponsorships. A book is different. It gives your ideas enough room to sit with your readers, quietly, in their favorite place, and it stays on their shelf long after the feed has moved on.

A product you own

Sell it directly to your audience, with no platform between you.

Authority that travels

"Published author" opens rooms you haven't entered yet: press, speaking, partnerships.

Something to hold

Your top supporters get something physical and lasting, not another digital perk.

How it works

Your material to your book, in days.

01

Share what you have

Paste your Substack, YouTube, or podcast, or drop in transcripts and notes. We pull and transcribe everything.

02

The Inkwell assembles your book

Our pipeline, built on patterns from 150+ bestselling nonfiction books, structures your content into a complete manuscript.

03

Shape it in your portal

Read every chapter, leave comments, request rewrites. You direct. We revise.

04

Turn on Typo for editorial review

Your built-in reviewer checks voice, flow, and cohesion. Every note links to the exact passage.

05

Export and publish

Print-ready PDF, ePub, or DOCX. Sell it on Amazon or to your audience directly.

您的内置审阅器会检查语音、流畅性和衔接性。 每个音符都链接到确切的段落。
